title: Remove Duplicated Run Wrappers on Change Commands in Compose Rs
description: Every Change*Command type in compose/rs/lib.rs defines both `apply` (which mutates and returns inverse fragments) and a `run` wrapper that does literally `self.apply(...)?; Ok(())`. The 14 `pub fn run` methods are identical boilerplate and only called from 2 test sites. Remove all the `run` methods on Change*Command types and switch the 2 test callers to call `apply` and discard the result. Keep the actor-loop `run` functions (lines 7076 and 7142) and the `apply` semantics unchanged.
summary:
Removed 14 duplicated `pub fn run(...)` wrapper methods on `Change*Command` types in `compose/rs/lib.rs`. Each was identical boilerplate (`self.apply(...)?; Ok(())`) and only used by 2 test sites — those now call `.apply(...)` directly and discard the inverse vec. The actor-loop `run` functions and the `apply` semantics are unchanged.

Also fixed a pre-existing compile error in `compose/store/jsonrpc.rs` where `ChangeKitCommand::apply_many` (returns `Vec<ChangeKitCommand>`) was being destructured as a tuple — the bug blocked the workspace build.

Verified: `cargo build --workspace` clean (only pre-existing dead-code warnings); `cargo test --workspace` 122 lib tests + 3 rpc integration tests all pass.
